primary.label: Save draft
primary.operation: One explicit original Native draft create with immutable request hash and transactional activity receipt.

secondary: Check original request after a lost acknowledgement; reads never recreate work

canonicalReadDomains: Original workflows/revisions and learned Source admission
Current Native membership, account and workflow grants
Current bounded Native workflow author policy and account/Source/revision ownership; a choice is not an execution grant or runtime qualification.
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Original workflowService.create composed transactionally with its Activity receipt; no parallel workflow store.
systemWork.authorityEffect: No schedules, grants, model calls, work or publication are created by described intent.
systemWork.asyncWork: Index examines at most 20 recent Native rows within existing four-request/1500ms admission; private source withdrawal is authoritative. Creation and receipt reads use Native database transactions.
systemWork.receipt: Exact company/creator/request/first-revision/creation-time identity. A missing row or receipt is unconfirmed; retained journals prevent replacement after deletion.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: The index has no readable records in its bounded current view; older or hidden records may exist.
states.partial: Oversized, duplicate, cyclic or dangling-connection flows show flow unavailable with no truncated topology.
states.stale: Remove retained private reads and controls during account, rollout or Source rechecks. Same-person unsent fields remain in memory.
states.validation_error: This read-only surface accepts no workflow inputs.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Check the immutable request with the Original owner. No automatic write retry, replacement key or absence inference.
states.success: Show only the exact current-account confirmed Original draft creation receipt; describe preparation/test/review as remaining, not successful.

navigation.back: Back returns to /workflows; unsent content is local until Save draft.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Only explicit Save creates a Native draft. Browser reload recovers admitted requests from a per-tab content-free locator.
navigation.resume: Exact admitted request locators are scoped to company and principal. No description/body/result enters browser persistence.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.
